decisions_made: Corrected my own earlier diagnosis rather than building on it: the open-world gap was missing fixture data, not missing renderer support. Verified by reading WorldView.ShowScene and the contract before changing anything.

Made the open world reachable via a selectable fixture rather than by changing what the renderer does on boot. Forcing the open world at boot would have meant the renderer deciding what to show instead of following the feed, which is exactly the boundary AGENTS.md §2 draws.

Authored the fixture at the repository-root tools/ rather than world-engine-godot/tools/, because .gitignore excludes the latter wholesale (it holds Godot's vendored C++ build scripts) and a tool placed there would never be committed.
Read agent heights from WorldGeometry.HeightAt instead of hand-authoring them, so the fixture cannot place a resident inside a hill and have that read as a rendering bug.
Derived fixture velocity as the derivative of the authored position rather than hand-picking it, after FeedReader correctly warned that the implied speed was faster than a person walks.

handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Two Godot Control placement traps are documented as comments at the site in ObserverRoot.PlaceDashboardChrome; read those before touching the overlays. (1) SetAnchorsPreset alone moves nothing — offsets stay 0, so a negative Position is measured from the left edge. (2) Re-anchoring a Control resizes it, because its rect derives from anchors and offsets together; sizes are now constants, never read back after a move. (3) GetGlobalRect().End.X is the window edge for a split's last child, so offset by the rail's Position.X instead. Separately: Array.IndexOf returns -1 for an absent flag and -1+1==0, so every 'value after flag' read must check at < 0 — ObserverCapture now routes all four through ValueAfter. Verify layout with the direct CLI --selftest (expect LAYOUT OK) and pass --fixture open-world-day to see the procedural world. Do not trust a black Fennara screenshot_scene result as a rendering failure, and do not rely on Fennara runtime_session to boot this scene. Always build with --no-incremental: an incremental build reported '0 warnings' while a clean one showed 5.
